stories.headline: Some People Think Elon Musk Snapped. The Controversial Four-Hour Documentary About Him Suggests Something Else. - Slate
stories.summary: Alex Gibney’s movie has an unfortunate twist.
stories.why: Gibney's documentary forces you to reckon with whether Musk's erratic behavior is calculated genius or genuine instability—a question that matters as his companies shape transportation, energy, and now information policy.

stories.headline: 'Pretty Ricky' Spectacular Smith Sued For Sexual Assault and Battery - TMZ
stories.summary: Pretty Ricky member Spectacular Smith is being sued by an Arizona woman who claims he messaged her on Instagram to meet up before sexually assaulting her.
stories.why: Pretty Ricky represented late-90s R&B nostalgia for your generation; this lawsuit signals how social media has weaponized celebrity access, turning Instagram DMs into a predation tool that destroys the artists you grew up with.

stories.headline: Horoscope for Sunday, 09/13/26 by Christopher Renstrom - sfgate.com
stories.summary: LEO (July 22 - Aug. 21): Good Fortune comes through others today. It could be a helpful tip or a lump sum from a long lost relative. Be on your best behavior.
stories.why: This is filler content masquerading as culture—skip it.

stories.headline: Pink hits back amid backlash for criticizing Macklemore’s anti-Israel concert rant - nypost.com
stories.summary: “I was born a Jew,” Pink said. “I didn’t pick it, and I’ve never hidden it.”
stories.why: Pink defending her Jewish identity against progressive pressure reveals the generational schism: older celebrities won't abandon principles for ideology, which matters if you're tired of cancel culture absolutism.

stories.headline: 'Misty Green' Review: Rosalind Eleazar Stars In Chris Rock Movie - Deadline
stories.summary: A review of Misty Green, writer-director Chris Rock's portrait of a down-and-out TV star played to the hilt by Rosalind Eleazar.
stories.why: Chris Rock directing a film about a washed-up performer is either self-aware genius or a desperate attempt to rehabilitate his image after Oscars slap—watching it tells you if he's genuinely reflective or just seeking relevance.

stories.headline: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother Review - ign.com
stories.summary: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother review: Mahershala Ali joins his would-be Blade director as a devout sword-wielding assassin.
stories.why: Mahershala Ali in a Blade film signals Marvel is finally committing to casting elite dramatic talent, not just action heroes—this could elevate superhero movies beyond spectacle or confirm they're still just IP laundering.

stories.headline: These 16 Famous People Are Now Serving Time, And Their Stories Will Shock You - BuzzFeed
stories.summary: One Homeland Security Investigations agent described what he found as "among the worst he had ever seen."
stories.why: Celebrity prison stories are pornographic outrage bait designed to make you feel morally superior; ignore unless you actually want substance on criminal justice.

stories.headline: Céline Dion Cries Happy Tears in Paris: 9 Best Moments From Opening Night of Her Return to Stage - Billboard
stories.summary: Opening night of Celine Dion's long-awaited comeback, a 26-date residency in Paris, featured a tearful start.
stories.why: Céline Dion's comeback despite Stiff Person Syndrome is a genuine moment of human resilience that transcends celebrity gossip—if you have aging parents or face health battles, this matters as proof that comebacks aren't just Hollywood narratives.
